traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Structure meets dream. Grounding imagination into reality, or pessimism colliding with illusion. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Expecting the worst, anxiety, and worry that mostly never materializes. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the limit/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

readerCopy.summary: If you are quietly supplying the missing time, money, or clarity that keeps a plan alive, the plan is not functioning as well as everyone says it is.
readerCopy.body: If you are quietly supplying the missing time, money, or clarity that keeps a plan alive, the plan is not functioning as well as everyone says it is. When Saturn squares Neptune, responsibility and idealism grind against each other until the gap between the vision and the support underneath it becomes impossible to keep covering. You can believe deeply in the purpose without volunteering to disguise every weakness in the structure. Your ability to compensate is not proof that the arrangement works.
